svg.aria-label: Sequence of ./build.sh uuu emmc between the PC running uuu, the Boot ROM, the U-Boot SPL, U-Boot and the on-module eMMC. With the boot switch on SD and no card, the ROM falls back to USB serial download (1fc9:0146). uuu streams imx-boot.bin to it with SDPS. The ROM starts the SPL, which trains the LPDDR4 and asks for the rest of the image: DDR firmware, TF-A BL31 and U-Boot. U-Boot sees it was started from USB and runs fastboot (1fc9:0152). The PC then sends fastboot commands: it selects mmc 2, writes the SD-card image to the eMMC user area, downloads imx-boot.bin and has U-Boot write it to boot0 and boot1 at offset 0, and sets the eMMC boot configuration to boot0 with mmc partconf. After the script the user powers off, sets the boot switch to eMMC and boots.
svg.text: The PC talks to the Boot ROM, then to the SPL, then to U-Boot's fastboot gadget, which does the eMMC writes. Time runs downward.
A · SERIAL DOWNLOAD: THE BOOT ROM TAKES THE BOOT IMAGE FROM THE PC
then asks the ROM for more
rest of imx-boot.bin: DDR firmware, BL31, U-Boot
B · U-BOOT'S FASTBOOT: THE PC DRIVES, U-BOOT WRITES THE eMMC
FB: ucmd setenv fastboot_dev mmc ; mmc dev ${emmc_dev}
user area: MBR · 32 KiB copy · p1
mmc write → boot0 and boot1, offset 0
Now you: power off, boot switch → eMMC, power on. The ROM reads boot0 at offset 0, the SPL starts, U-Boot mounts /dev/mmcblk2p1.
USB stream to the ROM / SPL
